entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We can't proceed any further unless we[n]can stop these.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, you think this controls those[n]swinging things!?
There's no reaction...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I didn't think it would be that easy. We'll[n]probably need some kind of key for it...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We gotta look for a key again?[n]What a pain in the ass...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Where would it be though? There weren't[n]any suspicious rooms on the way here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm... What do you think, Joker?
There has to be a hidden room.
An enemy has the key.
We don't need a key.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But according to our map, there isn't[n]anything of the sort...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think we can ignore that possibility[n]for the time being.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm... That probably would be the most[n]likely scenario...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm... From the look of it, this device[n]is the same as that one down in the[n]underground prison.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If it's not acting the same as that one,[n]we must need a key.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: An enemy? Y'mean one of them Shadows[n]that's roamin' around?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, how many of 'em do you think[n]there are? We can't beat the crap outta[n]all of them!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The key is for this tower, so it would have[n]to be one of the Shadows around here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: On top of that, it would have to be[n]a relatively high-ranking one.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then we just need to look for Shadows[n]like that and defeat them!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's do this, Joker! We need to find the[n]Shadow with that key!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, seein' this face pisses me off every[n]goddamn time...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This statue...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No, it might be dangerous to tamper with it.[n]Let's keep going for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We should look into what might be used[n]as a key for this.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Shadow that has it has to be wandering[n]around this tower.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We need two eyes for this.[n]Let's find the other one.
